title: HELIX FERPARestriction Resource
description: A student's FERPA directory information restriction. When active, directory information must be withheld from any disclosure not covered by a FERPA exception. Every downstream consumer of HELIX student data MUST check this resource before disclosing directory information.

student_ref.description: Reference to the HELIX Student resource.

restriction_type.description: Full = withhold everything. Directory = withhold directory info only. Partial = specific categories.

restricted_categories.description: Specific directory information categories restricted by the student.

restrict_directory.description: Master flag: if true, withhold ALL directory information.

end_date.description: Null if indefinite (most FERPA blocks persist until removed by the student).

is_active.description: Whether the restriction is currently in effect.

requested_date.description: Date the student submitted the restriction request.
